entities.name: Query PFK protein
observations: 342 aa protein with predicted molecular weight 36.4 kDa and theoretical pI 6.07.
Contains a Pfam PFK domain (PF00365.26) spanning residues 2-298.
Matches reviewed Streptomyces coelicolor PPi-dependent phosphofructokinase O08333 at 86.8% identity over 100% length, E-value 1e-222.
Strongly supported annotation: pyrophosphate-dependent phosphorylation of D-fructose 6-phosphate to fructose 1,6-bisphosphate in glycolysis.
Likely Mg2+-dependent cytoplasmic enzyme; homologs are homodimeric or homotetrameric and generally non-allosteric.
Sequence-based assignment does not independently establish exact substrate donor usage or oligomeric state.

entities.name: O08333
observations: EC 2.7.1.90; catalyzes beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + diphosphate = beta-D-fructose 1,6-bisphosphate + phosphate + H+.
Requires Mg2+ and functions in glycolysis and gluconeogenesis; annotated as cytoplasmic and homodimeric or homotetrameric.

entities.name: Canonical glycolysis
observations: PPi-dependent phosphofructokinase catalyzes the first committed phosphorylation step of glycolysis, converting fructose 6-phosphate to fructose 1,6-bisphosphate.

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate Mg2+ as the required cofactor for phosphofructokinase activity.
